claim_boundary: This matrix audits requirements and evidence status; it is not proof that pending human reviews or outcome studies have occurred.

rows.requirement: Every eligible source has an auditable identity, provenance and review state.
rows.basis: 395 queued videos; identity review remains an independent gate.
rows.remaining: Complete independent identity/duplication decisions before promotion.

rows.requirement: Retained captions are read in full context with source boundaries visible.
rows.remaining: Transcript evidence does not establish delivery or outcomes.

rows.requirement: Lessons expose exact words, phrases and repeatable speech forms in context.
rows.basis: 18 cards with exact examples; 50 heuristic phrase forms; cross-job forms are synthesized with explicit claim boundaries.
rows.remaining: Complete independent phrase-form review and adjudication.

rows.requirement: Each pattern names the communication job and labels why it might help as a hypothesis.
Verbal, vocal, pause, nonverbal, visual and setting evidence remain distinct with measurement limits.
rows.basis: The fixed-corpus audit links transcript lessons for 395 videos, raw A/V availability for 354 learner-route videos, and 364 proxy reports (7 without a retained itinerary entry); media/proxy records remain non-independent and non-semantic.
rows.remaining: Complete manual observation and independent multimodal review; missing media remains explicit.

rows.requirement: Candidate patterns are compared across speakers, events, topics and formats with denominators and holdouts.
rows.basis: Cross-job comparison has 153 pairs and an eligible-video denominator.
rows.remaining: Independently review 192 recurrence candidates and identity splits.

rows.requirement: Every major job has absent, failed, alternate-function, confound and misuse-limit slots.
rows.basis: 18 jobs and 90 blank slots are queued.
rows.remaining: Populate, independently review and adjudicate the slots; do not force candidates.

rows.requirement: Evidence becomes bounded practice with self-checks, non-fit warnings and linked web/mobile lessons.
rows.basis: 18 lessons and mobile payloads pass join validation; the cross-job guide adds adaptation and delivery-inspection prompts.
rows.remaining: Promotion depends on independent evidence and learner observations.

rows.requirement: A second reviewer checks important examples, interpretations, limits and safety boundaries.
rows.basis: Review workbooks and disagreement-preserving validators exist; no independent exports are present.

rows.requirement: Learners are tested for recognition, explanation, transfer, non-fit and revision.
rows.basis: 18 cards and 72 fixed tasks; zero records.
rows.remaining: Run the consented learner protocol and validate exports.

rows.requirement: Listener comprehension/recall is tested separately from corpus observations and learner teachability.
rows.basis: 18 jobs and 6 scored tasks; stimuli are not locked and records are zero.
rows.remaining: Complete independent stimulus review, lock pairs, then run the blinded study.

rows.requirement: The product preserves uncertainty, missing modalities, disagreement and non-causal claim language.
rows.basis: Shared entity/status contract and dashboard validators pass.
rows.remaining: Recheck these boundaries whenever evidence is promoted.
